name: magnetic-dock
description: A macOS-style magnetic dock with smooth scaling animations, spring physics, and premium micro-interactions. Supports both light and dark modes.

files.content:
/**
 * Real macOS app icons (Finder, Safari, Mail, Messages, Music, Photos, Calendar,
 * App Store, Maps, Notes, Terminal, System Settings, Trash) extracted from macOS
 * system applications, downscaled to 128px and embedded as base64 WebP data URIs.
 * Self-contained: no network requests, no extra files to download.
 *
 * Pass any of them as the `src` of a dock item to render it full-bleed.
 */
export const MACOS_APP_ICONS = {
    finder: "data:image/webp;base64,",
    safari: "data:image/webp;base64,",
    mail: "data:image/webp;base64,",
    messages: "data:image/webp;base64,",
    music: "data:image/webp;base64,",
    photos: "data:image/webp;base64,",
    calendar: "data:image/webp;base64,",
    appstore: "data:image/webp;base64,",
    maps: "data:image/webp;base64,",
    notes: "data:image/webp;base64,",
    terminal: "data:image/webp;base64,",
    settings: "data:image/webp;base64,",
    trash: "data:image/webp;base64,",
} as const

/** Ready-made dock preset using the real macOS app icons. */
export const MACOS_DOCK_ITEMS = [
    { id: "finder", label: "Finder", src: MACOS_APP_ICONS.finder, isActive: true },
    { id: "safari", label: "Safari", src: MACOS_APP_ICONS.safari },
    { id: "mail", label: "Mail", src: MACOS_APP_ICONS.mail, badge: 3 },
    { id: "messages", label: "Messages", src: MACOS_APP_ICONS.messages, badge: 12 },
    { id: "music", label: "Music", src: MACOS_APP_ICONS.music },
    { id: "photos", label: "Photos", src: MACOS_APP_ICONS.photos },
    { id: "calendar", label: "Calendar", src: MACOS_APP_ICONS.calendar },
    { id: "appstore", label: "App Store", src: MACOS_APP_ICONS.appstore },
    { id: "maps", label: "Maps", src: MACOS_APP_ICONS.maps },
    { id: "notes", label: "Notes", src: MACOS_APP_ICONS.notes },
    { id: "terminal", label: "Terminal", src: MACOS_APP_ICONS.terminal },
    { id: "settings", label: "System Settings", src: MACOS_APP_ICONS.settings },
    { id: "trash", label: "Trash", src: MACOS_APP_ICONS.trash },
]
